config.label: The myshopify
config.description: The myshopify.com store domain, e.g. my-store.myshopify.com. Overrides shopify.storeDomain from the config file.

config.label: Shopify Admin API access token
config.description: Shopify Admin API access token. Required and only ever read from the environment — never from the config file.

config.label: Path to a config
config.description: Path to a config.json with shopify/plans/approvalServer/protectedTags settings. Defaults to ./config.json in the working directory.

config.label: How long a plan token stays valid before it must be executed or expires, in milliseconds
config.description: How long a plan token stays valid before it must be executed or expires, in milliseconds. Default 60000.

config.label: Port the localhost human-approval HTTP server binds to (127
config.description: Port the localhost human-approval HTTP server binds to (127.0.0.1 only). Default 4319.

config.label: Comma-separated tags that plans may never modify; any plan touching an item carrying one is refused
config.description: Comma-separated tags that plans may never modify; any plan touching an item carrying one is refused. Default do-not-touch.

config.label: Identity recorded as the caller on every audit log row
config.description: Identity recorded as the caller on every audit log row. Default unknown.

config.label: File path for the tamper-evident JSONL audit log
config.description: File path for the tamper-evident JSONL audit log. Default shopify-operations-audit.jsonl in the working directory.
